title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Azadirachta indica
text: Azadirachta indica (local name: Neem / Nim) is found in Indian Subcontinent (India, Bangladesh, Pakistan, Nepal). Traditional medicinal uses: Used for skin diseases, infections, fever, dental care, blood purifier, diabetes support.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Azadirachta indica
text: Active compounds reported in Azadirachta indica: Azadirachtin, nimbin, nimbidin, nimbidol, flavonoids, tannins.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Azadirachta indica
text: Clinical evidence for Azadirachta indica: Strong lab evidence; limited human trials; some proven dental benefits.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Azadirachta indica
text: Side effects and safety of Azadirachta indica: High doses cause liver/kidney toxicity; neem oil dangerous for children.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Calotropis gigantea
text: Calotropis gigantea (local name: Akondo / Akanda) is found in South & Southeast Asia. Traditional medicinal uses: Used for respiratory issues, fever, pain, skin diseases, wound healing.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Calotropis gigantea
text: Active compounds reported in Calotropis gigantea: Cardenolides (calotropin, calotoxin), triterpenoids, flavonoids.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Calotropis gigantea
text: Clinical evidence for Calotropis gigantea: Animal-level evidence; no strong clinical trials.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Calotropis gigantea
text: Side effects and safety of Calotropis gigantea: Highly toxic; cardiac toxicity; latex irritant.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Datura metel
text: Datura metel (local name: Dhutura / Dhatura) is found in Tropical regions worldwide. Traditional medicinal uses: Traditionally for asthma, cough, pain, sedative; also hallucinogenic.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Datura metel
text: Active compounds reported in Datura metel: Atropine, scopolamine, hyoscyamine.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Datura metel
text: Clinical evidence for Datura metel: Well-known active compounds but dangerous; no safe clinical use.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Datura metel
text: Side effects and safety of Datura metel: Extremely poisonous—delirium, seizures, death.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Gynura procumbens
text: Gynura procumbens (local name: Sambung Nyawa) is found in Southeast Asia. Traditional medicinal uses: Used for diabetes, hypertension, cholesterol, inflammation; edible leaf.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Gynura procumbens
text: Active compounds reported in Gynura procumbens: Flavonoids, phenolic acids, terpenoids, sterols, saponins.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Gynura procumbens
text: Clinical evidence for Gynura procumbens: Strong animal evidence; limited human trials.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Gynura procumbens
text: Side effects and safety of Gynura procumbens: Generally safe; possible mild GI upset.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Heliotropium angiospermum
text: Heliotropium angiospermum (local name: Hatisur (related species)) is found in Tropical Asia & worldwide. Traditional medicinal uses: Used for skin diseases, wounds, inflammation, gout.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Heliotropium angiospermum
text: Active compounds reported in Heliotropium angiospermum: Pyrrolizidine alkaloids, terpenoids, flavonoids.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Heliotropium angiospermum
text: Clinical evidence for Heliotropium angiospermum: Lab evidence only; PAs cause liver toxicity.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Heliotropium angiospermum
text: Side effects and safety of Heliotropium angiospermum: Can cause serious liver damage.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Justicia adhatoda
text: Justicia adhatoda (local name: Basak / Vasaka) is found in South Asia. Traditional medicinal uses: Used for cough, asthma, bronchitis, TB support; joint pain.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Justicia adhatoda
text: Active compounds reported in Justicia adhatoda: Vasicine, vasicinone, flavonoids, tannins.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Justicia adhatoda
text: Clinical evidence for Justicia adhatoda: Strong traditional use; lab evidence; used in modern syrups.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Justicia adhatoda
text: Side effects and safety of Justicia adhatoda: Avoid high doses; avoid in pregnancy.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Mikania micrantha
text: Mikania micrantha (local name: Assam lata) is found in South Asia (invasive weed). Traditional medicinal uses: Used for wounds, fever, nausea, colds, rashes.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Mikania micrantha
text: Active compounds reported in Mikania micrantha: Sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, tannins.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Mikania micrantha
text: Clinical evidence for Mikania micrantha: Good wound healing results in lab; limited human data.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Mikania micrantha
text: Side effects and safety of Mikania micrantha: Possible allergies; limited safety data.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Rauvolfia tetraphylla
text: Rauvolfia tetraphylla (local name: Sarpagandha bon) is found in Tropical Asia & Americas. Traditional medicinal uses: Used for hypertension, mental disorders, sedation.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Rauvolfia tetraphylla
text: Active compounds reported in Rauvolfia tetraphylla: Reserpine-type indole alkaloids.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Rauvolfia tetraphylla
text: Clinical evidence for Rauvolfia tetraphylla: Clinically effective family of compounds but risky.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Rauvolfia tetraphylla
text: Side effects and safety of Rauvolfia tetraphylla: May cause depression, low BP, sedation.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Sida rhombifolia
text: Sida rhombifolia (local name: Bala) is found in Asia, Australia. Traditional medicinal uses: Used for diarrhea, fever, inflammation, asthma.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Sida rhombifolia
text: Active compounds reported in Sida rhombifolia: Ephedrine-like alkaloids, flavonoids, tannins.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Sida rhombifolia
text: Clinical evidence for Sida rhombifolia: Good lab evidence; no major clinical trials.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Sida rhombifolia
text: Side effects and safety of Sida rhombifolia: Raises BP; causes palpitations; avoid in heart disease.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Smilax zeylanica
text: Smilax zeylanica (local name: Ushava) is found in South & Southeast Asia. Traditional medicinal uses: Used for venereal diseases, ulcers, arthritis, skin diseases.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Smilax zeylanica
text: Active compounds reported in Smilax zeylanica: Steroidal saponins, β-sitosterol, phenolics.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Smilax zeylanica
text: Clinical evidence for Smilax zeylanica: Good lab evidence; limited clinical testing.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Smilax zeylanica
text: Side effects and safety of Smilax zeylanica: Mild GI issues; long-term safety uncertain.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Wissadula periplocifolia
text: Wissadula periplocifolia (local name: No common local name) is found in Tropical Americas & Asia. Traditional medicinal uses: Used for snake bites, inflammation, antiseptic.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Wissadula periplocifolia
text: Active compounds reported in Wissadula periplocifolia: Flavonoids (sulphated), phenolics.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Wissadula periplocifolia
text: Clinical evidence for Wissadula periplocifolia: Animal-level evidence only.

title: MediLeafNET plant sheet: Wissadula periplocifolia
text: Side effects and safety of Wissadula periplocifolia: Limited data; use cautiously.
